features: Customizable Earcups: Match your vibe every day with the boAt Rockerz Plus 550 Bluetooth Headphones, featuring customizable earcups. Effortlessly change the design and flaunt your unique style while enjoying your favorite tracks in comfort.
50mm Drivers: Feel every beat with powerful 50mm drivers that pump out punchy audio. boAt Signature Sound brings rich bass and vibrant clarity to elevate music, movies, and more.
Up to 100 Hours of Playback: Power through long playlists or back-to-back calls with up to 100 hours of battery life. Rockerz Plus 550 is built to keep up with your daily hustle.
Bluetooth v5.4 & AUX Compatibility: Whether you are going wireless with Bluetooth v5.4 or plugging in with AUX, these headphones give you flexible connectivity for every situation.
Dual Pairing: Stay effortlessly connected to two devices at once with your Rockerz. Take calls from your phone and seamlessly return to streaming on your tablet, all without the need to disconnect.
Easy Access Controls: Control your audio without lifting your phone. With conveniently placed control buttons, you can manage calls, adjust volume, pause music, and more with just a press.
Voice Assistant: Use your voice to get things done. Just activate Siri or Google Voice Assistant and set reminders, launch apps, or check the weather hands-free and hassle-free.
Ergonomic Over-the-Ear Design: Made for comfort, the over-the-ear design in these headphones fits your ears comfortably, so you can jam out for hours without strain.

Physical Noise Isolation: Stay focused during calls or immerse yourself in your music, even in noisy environments. Physical noise isolation helps block distractions for a smooth audio experience, indoors or out.
